## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger, previous behavior and final behavior.

## Verification

List the commands and browser/HTTP checks actually performed, with results. Record the port and isolated data setup for API checks. Explain checks that were skipped. For a documentation-only change, include the documentation link check.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe any permission, API, migration, backup or dependency impact. Link the related issue if one exists. Include synthetic screenshots for visible UI changes.

- [ ] The change is scoped to the stated problem.
- [ ] Relevant current guides, translations and Unreleased notes are updated.
- [ ] New API operations enforce server-side permissions and preserve shared-resource boundaries.
- [ ] Dependencies remain pinned and their purpose/license are recorded, if changed.
- [ ] No production data, credentials, private logs or local runtime files are included.
